integrity: Theorem proved by exact invariant identities and monotone polynomial; symbolic and 300 exact-rational tests in standalone verify.py. No independence or external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact unique threshold proved only for the directed three-state edge-rate 1:2:2 example; general a<b implies existence rather than uniqueness. The result compares stationary total variation, not finite-time/path-space errors. Earlier specialized treatment might overlap; 2013 repository full text was inaccessible.
title: Sharp stationary-error crossover for Lie and Strang splitting on a directed Markov cycle
